title: The Harbor of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Jude Lockridge
blurb: Rafael Sandoval, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
